survey.title: Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotics: A Review Towards Real-World Applications

criteria: Core: learns robot policies that map visual observations and natural-language instructions to actions or skills (vision-language-action models, language-conditioned imitation or reinforcement learning, generalist robot policies), including VLM/LLM-based planners whose output drives a robot.
Robot datasets, simulators, benchmarks and pretrained visual or action representations built for training or evaluating such policies also count.

Out of scope: vision-language models or LLMs with no robot or action component; robot learning without language conditioning or visual input; classical planning and control; pure navigation agents in non-robotic web or game environments.
